name: Ace of Cups
imagery: A hand emerges from a cloud holding a golden chalice from which five streams pour into a pond full of water lilies, while a white dove descends to place a cross-marked wafer into the cup. The dove and host speak of the Holy Spirit and divine grace, the five streams of the five senses awakened, and the lilies of emotion blossoming from deep, still waters.
meaning: The Ace of Cups is the pure root of Water: love, feeling and spiritual grace offered freely to you, as if from the hand of the divine itself. It heralds a new relationship, a reconciliation, a creative or emotional rebirth, or simply a heart that is finally ready to open again. Intuition runs strong and compassion comes easily, both for others and for yourself. This is a cup that refills as you pour, so let love move through you rather than hoarding it. Receive the blessing with open hands and let it soften whatever has been dry or guarded.
astrology: Root of the Powers of Water (Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces)
numerology: One: the seed, pure potential and new beginnings — here the first spark of feeling, love and spiritual receptivity.
affirmation: My heart is open, and love flows to me and through me without end.

ctx.past: Your story here began with an outpouring of feeling — a new love, a spiritual awakening, or a moment when your heart cracked open in the best way. That early grace still waters the roots of your current situation, and remembering it can remind you what you are truly capable of feeling.
ctx.present: Right now your cup is being filled. A fresh emotional beginning, a tender connection, or a wave of intuition is arriving, and the heart of the matter is whether you will let yourself receive it. Like the dove descending, this blessing is offered freely; you need only hold out your cup.
ctx.future: A new emotional chapter is coming toward you: love, healing, creative inspiration, or a spiritual opening that feels like water returning to parched ground. Keep your heart soft and receptive, because what flows in will overflow into other parts of your life as well.
ctx.challenge: The challenge here is feeling too much, or giving so freely that your cup runs dry. You may be pouring love into others while forgetting to let it in yourself, or drowning in emotion without channelling it. Ask for a vessel strong enough to hold what you feel.
ctx.advice: Open yourself to love and let it be simple. Say the kind thing, accept the invitation, begin the creative project your heart keeps whispering about. Try a water ritual — a cleansing bath, an offering poured onto the earth — to consecrate this new beginning and welcome grace in.
ctx.self: You are seeing yourself, or longing to see yourself, as someone with a full and open heart. There is a tenderness in you right now, a willingness to feel deeply and begin again. Honour that soft, intuitive part of you; it is not weakness but your truest wellspring.
ctx.others: Those around you see you as warm, kind and emotionally generous, or they are extending genuine affection toward you. Someone may be offering love, friendship or support with no strings attached. Let yourself notice the cups being held out in your direction.
ctx.hopes: You long for love that overflows — a connection, or a spiritual feeling, that fills you completely. Beneath that hope may lie a fear of being so open that you could be hurt. Both are natural; the five streams remind you that a living heart is meant to flow.
ctx.love: This is one of the loveliest cards for the heart: new romance, deepening intimacy, or love rekindled with fresh tenderness. Feelings are sincere and abundant. If you are single, open yourself to meeting someone; if partnered, pour fresh devotion into the bond and watch it bloom like the lilies.
ctx.work: Your work is ready to be infused with heart. This may signal a creative breakthrough, a role in caring or healing, or a project that genuinely moves you. Inspiration is flowing; let your emotional intelligence and compassion become assets in how you collaborate and create.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is offering you grace, plain and simple. The dove carrying the host is a sign that the divine is reaching toward you with love, and that your intuition is a sacred channel. Sit with water, listen inwardly, and trust the gentle nudges you receive.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that love is scarce or must be earned. Release old emotional dams — grudges, numbness, guardedness — that keep the waters from flowing. When you empty the cup of stale feelings, there is room for something fresh and holy to pour in.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface is a wellspring of feeling you may have been suppressing. Perhaps you secretly long for intimacy or spiritual connection but fear how much it could stir up. Your blind spot may be underestimating how deeply you are capable of loving.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is genuine love or a sincere emotional longing. Whatever else is happening, the core is about the heart: what you feel, what you want to feel, and the compassion that underlies your choices. Build from that tender, honest foundation.
ctx.gift: Your gift is an open, compassionate heart and a natural attunement to intuition. You can bring healing simply by being present and caring. Blessings may arrive unexpectedly as new love, kind support, or a moment of grace that restores your faith.

name: Two of Cups
imagery: A young man and woman face each other as equals, exchanging cups in a pledge of mutual affection. Above them floats the caduceus of Hermes crowned by a winged lion's head, symbols of healing, balanced opposites and passion uplifted into spirit, while a house stands peacefully in the green landscape behind them.
meaning: The Two of Cups is the card of a meeting of hearts: a partnership founded on mutual respect, attraction and genuine reciprocity. Often it signals new romance, a deepening bond, a reconciliation, or a friendship or business alliance where both sides give and receive in balance. The caduceus promises healing through connection, and the lion's head shows desire refined into something soulful. This card asks you to meet another person truly, seeing them clearly and letting yourself be seen. When two cups are raised together, the whole becomes greater than either part.
numerology: Two: duality, union and balance — the first meeting of self and other, here expressed as emotional partnership.
affirmation: I give and receive love in equal, joyful measure.

ctx.past: A meaningful partnership or meeting of hearts shaped where you are now. Perhaps a love, friendship or alliance taught you what true reciprocity feels like. Even if that bond has changed, its lesson of mutual respect remains part of your emotional foundation.
ctx.present: At the heart of this matter is a connection between equals. A relationship is forming, deepening or healing, and the energy between you and another person is sincere and balanced. Notice the pledge being made, spoken or unspoken, and honour it.
ctx.future: A harmonious union is on its way: a new romance, a renewed bond, or a partnership that brings out the best in both of you. This may also be a reconciliation after distance. Keep your heart honest and your expectations mutual, and this connection can flourish.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be imbalance in a bond — one person giving more, or losing themselves in merging with another. It can also mean idealising a connection rather than seeing the real person. Healthy union asks that you remain whole while you join.
ctx.advice: Reach out and meet someone halfway. Offer your cup first if needed: an apology, an invitation, a sincere compliment, a proposal of collaboration. Look for win-win solutions and treat others as equals. A simple ritual of sharing a drink with intention can seal a bond.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a partner and a connector, someone who values closeness and fairness. You may be learning to relate to yourself with the same kindness you offer a beloved. This card invites a loving inner marriage between your heart and mind.
ctx.others: Others see you as approachable and trustworthy, a good person to pair with. Someone around you may be feeling a real affinity or attraction toward you. The environment supports partnership, so outside influences are likely to bring you together with like-minded people.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a bond where you are truly seen and cherished as an equal. You may also fear that such a connection will not last, or that you will give more than you receive. The card reassures you that reciprocal love is possible and worth seeking.
ctx.love: A beautiful sign of mutual attraction and emotional compatibility. This can be a new romance with real chemistry, a commitment deepening, or partners rediscovering each other. Communication flows and affection is returned. For singles, a meaningful meeting may be close at hand.
ctx.work: Collaboration is your strength right now. A promising partnership, contract or creative duo could form, built on shared values and fair exchange. Choose allies whose vision complements yours, and negotiate in a spirit of mutual benefit rather than competition.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of sacred union — of the masculine and feminine, the human and the divine, the conscious and unconscious within you. The caduceus hints that your healing comes through connection. A guide or beloved ancestor may be reaching to partner with you now.
ctx.release: Release relationships that are lopsided or built on obligation rather than true reciprocity. You may also need to let go of a grudge that keeps you from reconciling. Clear space for bonds where both cups are raised willingly.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be an unspoken attraction or a deeper attachment than you have admitted, even to yourself. Your blind spot may be projecting your own ideals onto another person, seeing the reflection you hope for rather than who they truly are.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a relationship. Whatever is unfolding stems from a bond between two people, and the quality of that connection — its balance, honesty and care — is what everything else rests upon. Tend it well.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to create genuine connection. You bring out mutual understanding, smooth over divisions and make others feel valued. An ally or partner may appear as hidden help, offering support exactly where you need it.

name: Three of Cups
imagery: Three maidens in flowing robes dance in a garden, raising their cups high in a toast, with pumpkins, grapes and fruit of the harvest at their feet. They evoke the three Graces and a joyful circle of women celebrating together, their raised cups showing shared emotion and the harvest speaking of fruition and plenty.
meaning: The Three of Cups is a celebration of friendship, community and shared joy. It often marks gatherings — parties, reunions, weddings, birthdays, or simply a night of laughter with the people who know you best. Waite linked it to happy conclusions and abundance, and the harvest at the maidens' feet shows that efforts have come to fruit. This card reminds you that joy multiplies when it is shared, and that your circle of kindred spirits is a true source of healing. Gather your coven, lift your cup and honour what is going well.
numerology: Three: growth, creativity and expression — the first fruit of union, here the joy that spreads through a group.
affirmation: I am held by a joyful circle, and I celebrate the abundance around me.

ctx.past: Friendship and community helped carry you to this moment. A celebration, a supportive circle, or a time of shared happiness left an imprint that still nourishes you. Remember who stood with you, raised their cup with yours, and made the journey lighter.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter is connection and celebration. You are surrounded, or could be, by people who lift you up. There may be a gathering, good news to share, or a reason to toast. Let yourself enjoy it fully rather than rushing on to the next task.
ctx.future: Celebrations are coming — a reunion, a festive occasion, a happy announcement, or the warmth of a circle growing around you. Something you have nurtured will come to fruit and you will want to share it. Joy is on its way, and it arrives in company.
ctx.challenge: The shadow side here is overindulgence or using socialising to avoid deeper feelings. Too many parties, gossip, or a friendship circle that crowds out intimacy can drain you. Make sure your celebrations nourish rather than numb, and that your circle includes real honesty.
ctx.advice: Reach out to your people. Plan the gathering, call the friend, join the group or circle that has been calling you. Share your news and let others share theirs. A potluck, full moon circle or simple toast can strengthen bonds and invite more abundance.
ctx.self: You see yourself as part of a community, someone who belongs and who brings warmth to a group. Your inner child loves to play, dance and be included. Honour that social, joyful side of you; it is part of how your spirit stays bright.
ctx.others: Others see you as fun, warm and a good friend. Your environment is full of people who want to celebrate with you and support you. Outside influences right now are largely friendly and festive, bringing invitations and kindred connection.
ctx.hopes: You hope to belong — to have a circle of true friends who celebrate you just as you are. Perhaps you fear being left out or that the good times will not last. This card reminds you that your people are out there, and some are already near.
ctx.love: Love is light, joyful and social. This can point to meeting someone through friends, celebrating a milestone like an engagement, or enjoying a playful phase in a relationship. Keep in mind that friendship is a beautiful foundation for romance, and include your partner in your wider circle.
ctx.work: Teamwork and collaboration bring success. A project may wrap up happily, with recognition and shared credit. Networking, group creative ventures and community-focused work are favoured. Celebrate milestones with your colleagues; morale is a resource worth tending.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is reminding you of your soul family and your coven, seen and unseen. The three maidens echo the triple goddess and the Graces, honouring joy as sacred. Your guides want you to know that celebration is a form of prayer and gratitude.
ctx.release: Let go of isolation and the belief that you have to do everything alone. You may also need to release a friendship circle that no longer feels genuine, or habits of overindulgence. Keep the joy, and leave behind what only imitates it.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a longing for belonging you have not voiced, or a sense of being on the outside of the circle. Alternatively, gossip or rivalry could be simmering within a friendship group. Look honestly at your social bonds.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is community and shared experience. Your friendships, the groups you belong to and the joy you share with others underlie what is happening now. Your support network is a stronger foundation than you may realise.
ctx.gift: Your gift is a talent for bringing people together and creating joy. Friends may offer unexpected help, and good news may come through your community. Your capacity to celebrate others is itself a blessing that returns to you many times over.

name: Four of Cups
imagery: A young man sits cross-legged beneath a tree, arms folded, gazing at three cups lined up on the grass before him. A hand emerges from a cloud offering a fourth cup, which he does not yet notice. The scene shows withdrawal and discontent, but also meditation, and the offered cup represents a gift from spirit waiting to be seen.
meaning: The Four of Cups describes a period of turning inward, when what is on offer feels flat or unsatisfying. You may be bored, weary, or emotionally withdrawn, reflecting on what truly matters. Waite called it weariness and disgust, yet the tree's shelter also suggests meditation and needed rest. The danger is becoming so absorbed in what is lacking that you miss the new cup being offered from the clouds. Take your time to reassess, but lift your gaze — a fresh opportunity or spiritual gift may be closer than you think.
numerology: Four: stability, structure and stillness — here emotional stability tipping into stagnation and the need to pause.
affirmation: I pause with purpose, and I open my eyes to the gifts being offered to me.

ctx.past: A time of withdrawal or dissatisfaction helped shape your present. Perhaps you turned down an offer, felt numb to what you had, or needed space to think. That pause had its reasons, but consider whether a missed opportunity from back then still lingers in your thoughts.
ctx.present: You are in a contemplative, perhaps apathetic, place. What is in front of you does not excite you, and you may be questioning what you really want. Rest is fine, but notice whether you are overlooking a new offer or a fresh idea arriving quietly from the side.
ctx.future: A period of reflection is ahead, a time to step back and reassess your emotional priorities. Out of that stillness, a new offer or insight will appear. The key is to stay open enough to recognise the fourth cup when it comes, even if it is not what you expected.
ctx.challenge: Your block is apathy, discontent or closing yourself off. You may be so focused on what disappoints you that you cannot see what is going right or what is being offered. Folded arms can protect a tender heart, but they can also keep blessings out.
ctx.advice: Take a meditative pause, but do it with intention. Sit beneath your own tree — journal, walk, rest — and ask what you truly desire. Then look around with fresh eyes. Practise gratitude for the three cups you already have, and say yes to one new possibility.
ctx.self: You may see yourself as tired, uninspired or a little disconnected. Perhaps you feel that nothing quite satisfies you right now. Be gentle with yourself; this is a season of introspection, and your inner self is gathering the clarity it needs.
ctx.others: Others may see you as distant, aloof or uninterested, even if inside you are simply processing. Alternatively, someone around you may be withdrawn or unresponsive to what you offer. Give them space, while keeping your own heart open.
ctx.hopes: You hope for something that will genuinely move you — a feeling, path or connection that is truly yours. You may fear settling for less, or fear that nothing will ever feel right. Trust that clarity comes after stillness.
ctx.love: Love may feel stale or emotionally flat right now. One or both partners may be withdrawn, or you may be taking a good relationship for granted. If single, you may be turning down chances out of boredom or caution. Look again at what love is offering you.
ctx.work: Work may feel uninspiring and you might be questioning your path. Before you dismiss everything, check for overlooked opportunities, new projects or offers. This is a good time to reassess your goals, but avoid disengaging so fully that you miss your next step.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is holding out a cup you have not yet noticed. Your guides are offering inspiration, support or a new practice, but they need you to look up. Meditation is favoured; in quiet, you will see the hand emerging from the clouds.
ctx.release: Let go of apathy, resentment and the habit of dwelling on what is missing. Release the stubbornness that refuses what is offered simply because it is not exactly what you imagined. Unfold your arms and let new energy in.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the boredom may be disappointment or hurt you have not acknowledged. Your blind spot could be a real gift right beside you that you keep ignoring. Ask yourself what you are not letting yourself want.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is emotional fatigue or discontent. Something has left you uninspired, and that underlying weariness is colouring how you see everything else. Tending to it, through rest and honest reflection, will shift the whole picture.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity for deep introspection. You can sit with yourself and question what truly matters, rather than chasing every passing offer. Hidden help may come as a quiet opportunity or spiritual insight arriving from an unexpected direction.

name: Five of Cups
imagery: A figure wrapped in a black cloak bows their head over three spilled cups, while two upright cups stand untouched behind them. A river flows between the figure and a distant house, connected by a bridge. The cloak symbolises mourning, the spilled cups what has been lost, and the standing cups and bridge the hope and path home that still remain.
meaning: The Five of Cups acknowledges loss and the sorrow that follows it — a disappointment, a breakup, a plan that did not work out, or grief for what has ended. It honours the need to mourn; feelings must be felt to be healed. Yet the card also gently notes that not everything is gone: two cups still stand, and a bridge leads across the river toward home. When you are ready, you will turn around and see what remains. Grieve fully, then let compassion and hope guide you back across.
numerology: Five: disruption, challenge and change — here emotional loss that shakes the stability of the Four and leads to growth.
affirmation: I honour my grief, and I turn gently toward what still remains for me.

ctx.past: A loss or disappointment in your past has shaped where you stand now. You may have grieved deeply, or perhaps not fully allowed yourself to. Recognising that sorrow and the lessons it carried can help you understand your present feelings with compassion.
ctx.present: You are in the midst of disappointment or grief, focused on what has been spilled. That pain is real and deserves acknowledgement. At the same time, notice the two cups still standing behind you — there is something here worth turning toward when you are ready.
ctx.future: A period of disappointment or letting go may lie ahead, but it is not the end of the story. This card points to a passage through grief toward healing. The bridge is there for you to cross, and home — a sense of peace — waits on the other side.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is getting stuck in regret, replaying what went wrong until it blocks your view of anything else. Excess focus on loss can become a habit. Ask yourself whether mourning has turned into a place to hide from new possibilities.
ctx.advice: Allow yourself to grieve without judgement — cry, write, light a candle for what is gone. Then, gently, turn around and count your standing cups. Seek support from someone you trust. Forgive yourself for what you could not control, and take one small step toward the bridge.
ctx.self: You may see yourself through the lens of a recent loss, feeling heavy, regretful or disappointed. Your inner child may need comforting. Treat yourself as you would a grieving friend, with patience, warmth and the reminder that you are more than what you have lost.
ctx.others: Others may see you as sad or preoccupied, or someone around you may be going through their own grief. Your environment may contain disappointment or regret. Compassion, offered and received, is the healing current here.
ctx.hopes: You hope to recover what was lost, or to find peace with it. You may fear that the hurt will define you, or that you will never feel whole again. The card tenderly reassures you that healing is possible and that much still remains.
ctx.love: Love may be touched by heartbreak, disappointment or regret over past choices. This can point to a breakup or a rift that needs mourning. With time, honest acknowledgement and forgiveness, the standing cups suggest that love is still possible — with this person or another.
ctx.work: A setback, rejected proposal or project that did not go as hoped may be weighing on you. Take time to process the disappointment, then look at what is salvageable and what you have learned. Your skills and opportunities have not vanished.
ctx.spirit: Spirit sits with you in your sorrow. Your guides and ancestors want you to know that grief is a sacred passage and that you are not alone in it. The bridge is a symbol of their help, guiding you home to yourself when you are ready.
ctx.release: Release regret and the endless replay of 'if only'. Let go of what has spilled — you cannot gather it back, but you can honour it. A ritual of pouring water onto the earth can help you return your sorrow to the land.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be grief you have pushed away or regrets you have not admitted. Your blind spot might be focusing so much on loss that you cannot see the two cups standing behind you. Unprocessed sorrow is quietly asking for your attention.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a loss or disappointment. Something ended or did not unfold as hoped, and that experience underlies the feelings around you now. Acknowledging it honestly is the first step to building something new.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the depth of your feeling and your capacity to heal. Grief, when honoured, becomes wisdom and compassion for others. Hidden help is also present: there are resources, relationships and possibilities still standing, ready for you to reach for.

name: Six of Cups
imagery: In a quiet courtyard of an old village, a child offers another child a cup filled with white flowers, while an older figure walks away in the background. Six cups brimming with blossoms stand around them. The scene evokes innocence, childhood memories, and the sweetness of simple kindness, with the flowers as gifts of love from the past.
meaning: The Six of Cups is a card of nostalgia, innocence and the gentle sweetness of the past. It may bring a reunion with an old friend or lover, memories of childhood, or a return to a place or practice that once brought you comfort. Waite saw it as a card of the past and of fading things, and it often asks you to reconnect with your inner child's sense of play and wonder. Simple acts of kindness, gifts given freely and uncomplicated joy are favoured. Let the past nourish you without asking you to live there.
numerology: Six: harmony, giving and receiving, and balance restored — here the emotional harmony of memory and innocent generosity.
affirmation: I welcome the sweetness of my past and carry its innocence lightly into today.

ctx.past: Childhood experiences, early memories or a cherished old bond are shaping your current feelings. Something from long ago — perhaps a place, a person or a lesson in kindness — is still very much with you. Consider how those roots nourish you, and where they may still hold you back.
ctx.present: The past is present for you right now. You may be feeling nostalgic, reconnecting with old friends or revisiting familiar places. There is sweetness here, and an invitation to approach life with innocence and simple generosity. Enjoy the memories, but stay grounded in today.
ctx.future: A reunion, a reconnection or the return of something familiar is on its way. An old friend, a former love or a long-forgotten passion may reappear. This can bring healing and joy, especially if you meet it with openness rather than expectation that everything will be exactly as before.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is getting lost in nostalgia, idealising the past or clinging to how things used to be. You may be resisting growth by trying to recreate old comforts. Honour your memories, but do not let them become a cage that keeps you from the present.
ctx.advice: Reconnect with your inner child. Do something you loved when you were young — draw, play, climb a tree, visit an old haunt. Offer a small, sincere kindness to someone without expecting anything back. Reach out to an old friend you have been thinking of.
ctx.self: You see yourself, perhaps, through the eyes of who you once were. Your inner child is close to the surface, curious and tender. Let that part of you be heard; it holds wisdom about what genuinely brings you joy and safety.
ctx.others: Others may see you as kind, gentle and sincere, perhaps with a youthful or nurturing quality. Someone from your past may be thinking of you or reaching out. Your environment may include family or old friends who play an important role right now.
ctx.hopes: You hope to recapture a sense of innocence, safety or happiness from an earlier time. You may fear that the best days are behind you. The card reassures you that the joy of the past can be rekindled in new forms in the present.
ctx.love: Love has a sweet, tender quality. This can point to a childhood sweetheart, an old flame returning, or a relationship that feels comfortable and safe. Playfulness and simple gestures of affection strengthen the bond. Be mindful not to measure new love against idealised memories.
ctx.work: Work may involve returning to an old project, skill or passion, or collaborating with people from your past. Creative work inspired by memory or childhood themes is favoured, as are jobs involving children, education or caregiving. Generosity in your workplace pays off.
ctx.spirit: Spirit may be reaching you through memory — an ancestor, a childhood guide, or a spiritual practice you once loved. Your guides are inviting you to remember who you were before the world told you who to be. Innocence itself can be a doorway to the sacred.
ctx.release: Release old memories that keep you stuck, or the rosy-tinted version of the past that makes today feel lacking. You may need to let go of an old relationship pattern learned in childhood. Bless what was, and step forward lighter.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be unprocessed childhood experiences or longings shaping your choices without your noticing. Your blind spot might be unconsciously recreating old dynamics or yearning for a past that never quite existed as you remember it.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lie memories and early experiences. What you learned about love, kindness and safety when you were young underlies what is happening now. Understanding those roots will help you make conscious choices today.
ctx.gift: Your gift is a gentle, generous heart and a capacity for wonder. You know how to give simply and sincerely. Hidden help may come from an old friend, a family member, or a happy memory that reminds you of your own resilience and joy.

name: Seven of Cups
imagery: A figure, seen in silhouette, stands before seven cups floating in the clouds, each holding a different vision: a head, a veiled glowing figure, a serpent, a castle, jewels, a laurel wreath and a dragon. The cups represent the many dreams, temptations and illusions of the imagination, from fame and riches to danger and spiritual mystery, all shimmering but not yet real.
meaning: The Seven of Cups shows a mind full of possibilities, dreams and fantasies, some inspired and some illusory. Waite called it fairy favours and images of reflection: castles in the air that may dazzle but are not yet grounded. You may be facing many options and feel unsure which is real, or getting lost in daydreams rather than taking action. This card honours the power of imagination and vision while asking you to discern carefully. Choose one cup, bring it down to earth, and start giving it form.
numerology: Seven: reflection, mystery and testing — here the testing of desires and the need to discern illusion from truth.
affirmation: I dream boldly, discern wisely and choose the path that is truly mine.

ctx.past: In the past you may have been swept up in dreams or overwhelmed by too many choices. Perhaps a fantasy or illusion led you astray, or you hesitated to commit. Those experiences can now teach you how to tell an inspired vision from a passing temptation.
ctx.present: You stand before many cups, each glowing with a different possibility. Your imagination is rich, but clarity may be lacking. Some options are real, others are illusions. The heart of the matter is learning to discern and choose rather than simply dreaming.
ctx.future: Many choices and possibilities are on their way. This can be exciting, but it will ask you to separate fantasy from substance. Look closely at what each option truly offers, and be wary of anything that seems too good to be true.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is illusion, indecision or wishful thinking. You may be chasing fantasies, avoiding reality, or scattering your energy across too many dreams. The shimmering cups can be distracting. Ground yourself and ask which of them is truly worth pursuing.
ctx.advice: Write down your options and look at each one honestly. Which are aligned with your values, and which only glitter? Use divination, meditation or journalling to see more clearly, then choose one cup and take a concrete step toward making it real.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a dreamer with a vivid imagination and many possible paths. You may feel pulled in different directions. Your inner child loves to imagine; honour that, while also asking your wiser self to help you choose.
ctx.others: Others may see you as imaginative, inspired or a little scattered. Your environment may be full of options, temptations or people offering promises. Be discerning about what others present to you, and look beneath appearances.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a dream to come true — maybe several at once. You may fear choosing the wrong path, or that your wishes are only illusions. The card encourages you to dream, yet also to be practical about which dreams you invest in.
ctx.love: Love may be clouded by fantasy or idealisation. You may be dreaming about a perfect partner, unsure between options, or seeing someone through rose-tinted glasses. Look for the real person behind the vision, and be honest about what you truly want in a bond.
ctx.work: Many career options or creative ideas are swirling around. This is fertile ground for vision and brainstorming, but you will need focus to make anything happen. Evaluate offers carefully, especially those that seem dazzling, and commit to one project you can ground.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is speaking through dreams, visions and the imagination. Some of these messages carry real guidance; others are your own desires reflected back. The veiled figure in the central cup invites you to seek the deeper mystery with discernment and patience.
ctx.release: Release illusions and fantasies that keep you from acting in the real world. Let go of the options that only glitter, and of the fear of missing out that makes you want everything at once. Clearing the clouds makes room for true vision.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be escapism or self-deception. You may be avoiding a hard truth by dwelling in daydreams, or not admitting which temptation truly draws you. Your blind spot might be a cup with a serpent in it, disguised as something lovely.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is imagination and choice. The many possibilities you are considering, and the dreams you hold, underlie what is happening now. Clarity about what you truly want will steady everything that grows from here.
ctx.gift: Your gift is a powerful imagination and the ability to envision many possibilities. This is a creative and magical strength. Hidden help may come as a dream, a vision or a sudden insight that shows you which cup holds real treasure.

name: Eight of Cups
imagery: A cloaked figure with a staff walks away from eight carefully stacked cups toward rocky hills under a waning moon that watches from the night sky. A gap in the stacked cups hints that something is missing. The moon speaks of intuition and cycles ending, the staff of the journey, and the barren path of a quest for something more meaningful than what is left behind.
meaning: The Eight of Cups is the card of walking away from something that no longer fulfils you, even when it looks complete from the outside. You may sense that a relationship, job or way of life has given what it can, and your soul is asking for deeper meaning. Waite tied it to the decline of a matter, and modern readers see a brave, intuitive departure. Leaving is not failure; it is honouring your growth. Trust the moonlight of your intuition to guide you toward what is truly nourishing.
numerology: Eight: movement, power and cycles of change — here the emotional strength to move on in search of deeper meaning.
affirmation: I have the courage to walk away from what no longer feeds my soul.

ctx.past: At some point you walked away from something that once mattered — a relationship, a place, a path. That choice, though perhaps painful, shaped who you are now. Recognise the courage it took and the deeper meaning you were seeking when you set out.
ctx.present: You are at a turning point where what you have no longer satisfies you. Even if things look fine on the surface, something essential is missing. The heart of the matter is whether to stay with what is familiar or follow the quiet call toward something more meaningful.
ctx.future: A departure or transition is ahead. You may choose to leave behind a situation that has run its course, setting out on a journey — inner or outer — to find greater fulfilment. Though uncertain, this path leads toward deeper truth and emotional maturity.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is the pull to escape rather than face things, or the fear of leaving what is known. You may be wandering restlessly from one situation to another without truly resolving anything. Ask whether you are seeking meaning or simply avoiding discomfort.
ctx.advice: Listen to your intuition about what is no longer working. If it is time to go, go with grace — say your goodbyes, gather what you need and set off. Retreat into solitude or nature to reconnect with your inner compass. A waning moon ritual can support this release.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone outgrowing your old life. You may feel restless, introspective or ready for a deeper path. Your inner self knows that you are seeking more than comfort; trust that wisdom, even when it feels lonely.
ctx.others: Others may see you as withdrawing or moving on, and some may not understand your reasons. Alternatively, someone in your life may be walking away from a situation or relationship. Respect the journey, whether it is yours or theirs.
ctx.hopes: You hope to find something truly meaningful — a path, love or purpose that fills the empty space. You may fear leaving behind what you have built, or fear that nothing better awaits. The card encourages you to trust your inner moonlight.
ctx.love: A relationship may feel emotionally empty, and you or your partner may be considering walking away. This can also mean seeking more depth within a bond. Be honest about what is missing. Sometimes love requires leaving; sometimes it requires a deeper, more soulful commitment.
ctx.work: You may feel unfulfilled in your job or creative work, even if it looks successful. This card supports seeking a path more aligned with your values, perhaps through a career change, sabbatical or new direction. Plan wisely, but do not ignore the call.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is calling you into a quest for meaning. Your guides may be urging solitude, pilgrimage or retreat. The moon watches over you, a reminder that intuition will light your way through the darkness. This is a sacred journey toward your higher self.
ctx.release: Release what no longer feeds your soul — a role, relationship, habit or dream that has run its course. Let go of the fear of disappointing others by leaving. Honour what was given, then walk on with a lighter heart.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a deep dissatisfaction you have not admitted, even to yourself. You may be clinging to something out of fear while secretly longing to leave. Your blind spot could be the gap in the stacked cups, the missing piece you keep pretending is not there.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a longing for deeper meaning. Something feels incomplete, and that emotional emptiness underlies what is happening. Understanding what your soul is truly seeking will guide your next steps.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to let go and the wisdom to seek what truly matters. You are able to walk away from comfort in pursuit of truth. Hidden help may appear along the path, as guidance, solitude or a sudden clarity under the moon.

name: Nine of Cups
imagery: A contented man sits on a wooden bench with arms folded and a satisfied smile, while nine golden cups are displayed on a curved, cloth-draped table behind him. Known as the wish card, it shows material and emotional desires fulfilled. The arc of cups is like a rainbow of blessings, and his posture shows pride, comfort and well-earned enjoyment.
meaning: The Nine of Cups is famously the wish card: whatever you have longed for has a strong chance of coming true. It speaks of contentment, emotional satisfaction and the pleasures of life — good food, comfort, success and the feeling that all is well. Waite described it as concord, contentment and physical bien-être. This is a moment to savour your blessings and feel gratitude for them. Make your wish clearly and with an open heart, then enjoy the abundance that is flowing toward you.
numerology: Nine: completion, fulfilment and near-culmination — here emotional and material satisfaction reaching its peak.
affirmation: My wishes are coming true, and I am grateful for every blessing in my life.

ctx.past: In the past you achieved something you had longed for, or enjoyed a period of contentment and ease. That fulfilment laid down roots of confidence and gratitude. Remember that time; it is proof that your wishes can and do come true.
ctx.present: You are in a place of contentment, or very close to it. A wish may be coming true and there is much to be grateful for. The heart of the matter is learning to enjoy what you have, savouring life's pleasures and allowing yourself to feel satisfied.
ctx.future: Your wish is on its way. This is one of the most positive outcomes in the deck, promising satisfaction, comfort and joy. Keep your intentions clear and your gratitude flowing, and you are likely to find yourself smiling at what unfolds.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is complacency, smugness or overindulgence. You may be relying on material comforts for happiness, or resting so comfortably that you stop growing. Ask whether your satisfaction is deep and soulful, or only on the surface.
ctx.advice: Make your wish clearly and with intention — write it, speak it, place it on your altar. Then practise gratitude for what you already have. Indulge in a pleasure that nourishes you: a fine meal, a soothing bath, time with loved ones. Let yourself enjoy.
ctx.self: You see yourself as content, accomplished or well on your way. There is a quiet pride in what you have achieved. Your inner child is delighted; let them revel in the joy, and let yourself feel worthy of your blessings.
ctx.others: Others see you as successful, happy and comfortable, someone who has their life together. Your environment is supportive and generous. People around you may be eager to share in your good fortune or to help your wishes come true.
ctx.hopes: You hope for your heart's desire to manifest. You may also fear that once you have it, it will not satisfy you, or that you do not deserve it. The card reassures you that fulfilment is possible and that you are worthy of happiness.
ctx.love: Emotional satisfaction in love: a relationship that feels good, a wish for romance coming true, or simply contentment in your own company. Enjoy pleasure and affection. If you are wishing for love, this card suggests your desires are being heard.
ctx.work: Success, recognition and satisfaction in your work. A goal may be reached, a project completed to your pleasure, or financial comfort improved. Enjoy the rewards of your efforts, and keep your ambitions aligned with what truly makes you happy.
ctx.spirit: Spirit smiles on your wishes. Your guides are reminding you that joy, pleasure and abundance are sacred too. Gratitude is the most powerful spell you can cast right now; give thanks, and more blessings will flow.
ctx.release: Release the belief that you must earn every pleasure through struggle. Let go of guilt around enjoyment, and of chasing more when you already have plenty. You may also need to release a wish that, on reflection, is not truly yours.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a reliance on outer comforts to fill an inner gap, or a smugness that keeps others at a distance. Your blind spot might be not realising how much you already have, or not admitting what you truly wish for.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a deep desire for fulfilment and contentment. Your wishes and the pursuit of happiness underlie what is happening now. When you know what you truly want, the path to it becomes much clearer.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity for joy, gratitude and satisfaction. You know how to appreciate the good things in life. Hidden blessings and good fortune are around you; a wish may come true in an unexpected and delightful way.

name: Ten of Cups
imagery: A couple stands with arms around each other, raising their arms toward a rainbow of ten cups arching across the sky, while two children dance joyfully beside them. A cosy home sits nestled among green hills and a gentle river. The rainbow symbolises divine blessing and promise, and the family scene represents emotional fulfilment, harmony and love shared across generations.
meaning: The Ten of Cups is the card of emotional fulfilment and lasting happiness, often described as the happily-ever-after card. It speaks of a loving home, harmonious family relationships, and the deep contentment that comes from belonging. Waite called it contentment and repose of the entire heart, and the rainbow overhead is a promise of blessing. Whether your family is by blood or by choice, this card celebrates love that is shared, sustained and nourishing. Let yourself feel truly at home in your life.
numerology: Ten: completion and fullness of a cycle — here emotional fulfilment brought to its happiest culmination.
affirmation: I am surrounded by love, and my home is a place of harmony and joy.

ctx.past: A loving home, family or community shaped your foundations. Perhaps you knew harmony and belonging, or a particular period stands out as a time of true happiness. Those memories are a wellspring you can return to for strength and inspiration.
ctx.present: You are surrounded by love and emotional harmony, or close to creating it. The heart of the matter is your sense of home and belonging. Take time to appreciate the people who make your life rich, and the peace that comes from shared joy.
ctx.future: Lasting happiness and emotional fulfilment are coming. This can point to family celebrations, a relationship reaching a joyful milestone, a new home, or simply the deep peace of feeling you belong. Your rainbow is on its way.
ctx.challenge: The challenge may be an idealised vision of happiness that leaves no room for real-life imperfection. You might be trying to keep up a picture of harmony while ignoring tensions underneath. True fulfilment includes honesty, not only appearances.
ctx.advice: Invest in your relationships and your home. Spend quality time with family or chosen family, create rituals of togetherness, and bless your hearth. Speak your love openly. Focus on what truly matters to your heart rather than what looks impressive.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone who values love, family and harmony. You may be feeling deeply content, or longing for that kind of belonging. Your inner child wants to dance beneath the rainbow; let them know they are safe and loved.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, loving and family-oriented, someone who creates harmony. Your environment is supportive and nurturing. Family or close friends may be playing a significant and joyful role in your situation, and their goodwill is a real resource you can lean on.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a happy home, lasting love and a sense of belonging. You may fear that such happiness is out of reach or will not last. The card reminds you that emotional fulfilment is possible and that you deserve it.
ctx.love: A wonderful card for love: commitment, harmony and long-term happiness. It can point to moving in together, marriage, starting a family, or a relationship that feels like home. If you are single, it encourages you to know what your ideal partnership truly looks like.
ctx.work: Work brings emotional satisfaction and a sense of belonging, perhaps through a supportive team that feels like family. Work-life balance is favoured, and success may come from aligning your career with your values. Family businesses and home-based work are also highlighted.
ctx.spirit: Spirit offers a blessing of harmony, like the rainbow after rain. Your ancestors may be smiling on your family line, and your guides want you to know that love itself is a spiritual path. Gratitude for your home and loved ones is a powerful offering.
ctx.release: Release the pressure to have a picture-perfect family or relationship. Let go of old family wounds that keep you from enjoying the love available now. You might also release comparisons to others' happiness, and embrace your own unique version of home.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a longing for belonging you rarely voice, or family tensions masked by a happy surface. Your blind spot might be not recognising how much love already surrounds you, or how much you yearn for deeper roots.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is the desire for love, family and belonging. Your home life and closest relationships underlie what is happening now. Strengthening those bonds will bring stability and joy to everything else.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to create a loving, harmonious environment where others feel at home. You bring people together and nurture lasting bonds. Hidden blessings may come through family, community or the simple peace of feeling you belong.

name: Page of Cups
imagery: A young page in a floral tunic and soft blue hat stands by the sea, holding a cup from which a small fish pops its head, gazing at it with surprise and delight. The waves behind him roll gently. The fish is a symbol of intuition, imagination and messages from the unconscious emerging unexpectedly, and the page's open curiosity shows a heart ready to receive them.
meaning: The Page of Cups brings a message of the heart: a creative spark, a surprising intuition, or a sweet new feeling. Waite described him as a studious youth and a bearer of news, and the fish in his cup is the delightful unexpected — an idea or emotion surfacing from your depths. This page asks you to stay curious, playful and open to the whimsical. Pay attention to dreams, synchronicities and sudden inspirations. Sometimes this card also represents a sensitive, imaginative young person or a gentle invitation to love.
astrology: Earth of Water (rules the Water quadrant: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces)
numerology: Page: the student and messenger — the earthy, beginning stage of the suit's energy, open to learning and new feeling.
affirmation: I welcome the surprises of my heart and trust the messages of my intuition.

ctx.past: A creative spark, intuitive message or gentle new feeling arrived in your past and helped set things in motion. Perhaps you were more open and playful then. Reconnecting with that youthful curiosity can help you understand where your present path began.
ctx.present: A message from the heart is arriving. You may be feeling sudden inspiration, an unexpected attraction or a strong intuitive nudge. The heart of the matter is your willingness to stay open and curious, like the page looking at the fish in wonder.
ctx.future: News of the heart is on its way: a creative opportunity, an invitation, a love note or an intuitive insight that delights you. Stay playful and receptive, because what is coming may surprise you in the loveliest way.
ctx.challenge: The challenge here is emotional immaturity, oversensitivity or living too much in daydreams. You may take things personally, or hesitate to act on your creative impulses. Ground your feelings and give your ideas some form so they do not drift away.
ctx.advice: Follow your curiosity. Play with a new creative project, keep a dream journal, or try a form of divination that intrigues you. Express your feelings with innocence and honesty. Let yourself be a beginner, and be gentle with yourself as you learn.
ctx.self: You see yourself as sensitive, creative and open to life's wonders. Your inner child is very present, eager to play and explore. Honour that side of you, even if the world sometimes encourages you to be more serious.
ctx.others: Others see you as gentle, imaginative and a bit of a dreamer. Someone young or young at heart may be bringing you a message, a gift or a sweet gesture. Your environment encourages creativity and emotional openness.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a delightful surprise — a new love, a creative breakthrough or a sign from the universe. You may fear being too sensitive or naive. The card encourages you to keep your heart open; the fish appears for those who look.
ctx.love: Sweet beginnings in love: a crush, a flirtatious message, a tender confession or an invitation. This can point to a new romance or a playful phase in an existing relationship. Express your feelings simply and sincerely, and enjoy the innocence of it.
ctx.work: Creative inspiration is flowing. A new idea, project or opportunity in the arts, healing or caring fields may present itself. Stay open to learning and experimenting. Your imagination and emotional intelligence are valuable assets right now.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is sending you messages through symbols, dreams and synchronicities. Like the fish rising from the cup, your intuition is speaking in surprising ways. Keep a journal and notice what recurs; your guides are playful and want you to listen.
ctx.release: Release the need to be serious and in control all the time. Let go of embarrassment about your feelings or your creative dreams. You may also need to release emotional immaturity or a tendency to retreat into fantasy when life gets hard.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a sensitive, creative part of you that you have kept quiet. Your blind spot might be how strongly your feelings sway your decisions, or a crush or longing you have not admitted. Let your hidden imagination surface.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is an emotional or creative impulse. A feeling, a dream or a spark of inspiration underlies what is happening. Honouring that innocent impulse can bring clarity and joy to everything else.
ctx.gift: Your gift is creative imagination and intuitive openness. You can see magic in ordinary things and receive inspiration easily. Hidden help may come as a surprising message, a dream or a playful encounter that lights up your path.

name: Knight of Cups
imagery: A knight in armour decorated with fish rides a calm white horse at a slow, graceful pace, holding out a golden cup as if offering it. His helmet and heels bear wings, and a river flows through the landscape before him. The winged helm speaks of imagination and Hermes the messenger, the fish of emotion and intuition, and the steady horse of a heart moving gently toward its desire.
meaning: The Knight of Cups is the romantic, the dreamer and the bearer of heartfelt offers. He follows his feelings and his ideals, moving gracefully toward what inspires him. Waite described him as one who brings messages, approaches, propositions and invitations. This card often heralds romance, creative proposals or the call to follow your heart's quest. He asks you to act on your feelings with grace and sincerity, while staying mindful that ideals must eventually meet reality. Let love and beauty lead the way.
numerology: Knight: action and movement — the active, questing stage of the suit, carrying its energy outward into the world.
affirmation: I follow my heart with grace, and I offer my love sincerely.

ctx.past: A romantic gesture, heartfelt offer or season of following your dreams shaped your current situation. Perhaps you or someone else acted from the heart and set things in motion. Those idealistic choices still colour how you approach love and creativity today.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter is following your feelings. An offer, invitation or romantic opportunity may be in front of you, or you may be called to pursue a creative dream. Move forward gracefully, guided by both sincerity and good sense.
ctx.future: A heartfelt offer or romantic invitation is on its way. This could be a proposal, a new admirer, a creative opportunity or a meaningful message. Approach it with an open heart, and take time to see whether it is as solid as it is beautiful.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is idealism without grounding, or moodiness that makes you hard to rely on. You may be chasing a dream that sounds lovely but lacks substance, or getting swept away by charm. Balance your romantic heart with honest discernment.
ctx.advice: Let your heart lead, and act on your feelings with grace. Make the gesture, send the message, share your creative work. Express your emotions artfully and sincerely. At the same time, check that your ideals are aligned with practical reality before you commit fully.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a romantic, a creative spirit and someone guided by feeling. You may be idealistic and sensitive, longing for beauty and meaning. Honour your dreams while giving them the steady pace of the knight's calm horse.
ctx.others: Others see you as charming, gentle and kind-hearted, perhaps a little dreamy. Someone around you may be approaching with an offer or romantic intention. Notice who is bringing you a cup; their sincerity is worth weighing carefully.
ctx.hopes: You hope for romance, inspiration and a life that feels like poetry. You may fear that your ideals will be disappointed, or that someone's charm hides a lack of substance. The card encourages you to keep your heart open and your eyes clear.
ctx.love: A wonderful card for romance: a suitor, a proposal, a declaration of love or a deeply romantic phase. Feelings are expressed sweetly and sincerely. Enjoy the courtship, and give it time to show whether the connection is lasting.
ctx.work: Creative work and opportunities aligned with your passions are favoured. You may receive an offer or proposal that appeals to your heart. Bring artistry, diplomacy and emotional intelligence to your work, while making sure dreams are paired with practical plans.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you on a quest of the heart. Your guides may be urging you to follow your intuition and pursue a path of beauty, art or devotion. The winged helm reminds you that your imagination carries divine messages; listen closely.
ctx.release: Release unrealistic expectations and the habit of waiting for a perfect fairy-tale. Let go of moodiness or a tendency to drift when life becomes difficult. Keep your romantic spirit, but release the illusions that keep you from real connection.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be idealism that blinds you to reality, or a romantic longing you have not admitted. Your blind spot might be falling for a person or idea because it looks beautiful, without checking what lies beneath the shining armour.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a heartfelt desire or ideal. Your feelings, dreams and longing for beauty or romance underlie what is happening now. Honour that core while giving it a grounded direction.
ctx.gift: Your gift is grace, charm and the courage to follow your heart. You can bring beauty and romance into ordinary life. Hidden help may come as an invitation, an offer or a kind gesture that opens a new and inspiring path.

name: Queen of Cups
imagery: A queen sits on an ornate throne carved with sea-nymphs and a cherub at the very edge of the sea, gazing intently into an elaborate closed cup crowned with angels' wings. Waves lap at her feet, and pebbles in the foreground glint. The closed cup symbolises the mysteries of the unconscious, which she contemplates with deep intuition, and the water around her shows her emotional fluency and union with the depths.
meaning: The Queen of Cups is the embodiment of compassion, intuition and emotional wisdom. Waite described her as good, fair, honest and devoted, one who sees visions in her cup. She feels deeply yet stays centred, holding space for others without being swept away. This card invites you to trust your intuition, nurture yourself and those around you, and honour your emotional and psychic gifts. Often she represents a caring, empathic person in your life — or the healer within you. Let your heart be both soft and wise.
numerology: Queen: mastery turned inward — the nurturing, receptive mastery of the suit, holding its energy with maturity.
affirmation: I trust my intuition and hold my heart and others with deep compassion.

ctx.past: A nurturing, intuitive presence — perhaps a mother figure, mentor or your own wise heart — shaped your past. You may have learned compassion and emotional depth from someone who held space for you. That influence still supports you, even if quietly.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter calls for compassion and intuition. You may be in a caring role, or deeply attuned to feelings, your own and others'. Trust what you sense beneath the surface, and stay centred so that empathy nourishes rather than overwhelms you.
ctx.future: You are moving into a time of emotional wisdom, intuitive insight and nurturing connection. A compassionate person may enter your life, or you may step more fully into your role as a healer or caregiver. Your intuition will guide you well.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is empathy without boundaries, absorbing others' emotions until you lose yourself. You may be overly sensitive, caretaking at your own expense, or living too much in your inner world. Remember that the queen sits on solid ground at the water's edge.
ctx.advice: Listen to your intuition and trust it. Make time for self-care and emotional reflection — a ritual bath, meditation, scrying with water. Offer compassion to others, but keep your boundaries clear. Let your feelings guide you, and speak from the heart with kindness.
ctx.self: You see yourself as caring, intuitive and emotionally attuned. You may be the one others turn to for comfort. Honour your sensitivity as a gift, and remember that you, too, deserve the nurturing you offer so freely.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, empathic and wise, a safe harbour. A compassionate, intuitive person in your environment may be offering support. Outside influences encourage emotional openness and tender care, so let yourself be supported as generously as you support others.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel deeply understood and to be a loving presence for others. You may fear being overwhelmed by emotion or taken advantage of because of your kindness. The card reassures you that compassion and boundaries can coexist.
ctx.love: Love is nurturing, intuitive and emotionally deep. This card often signals a caring partner or a relationship built on empathy and understanding. Listen to your heart and your partner's unspoken feelings, and let tenderness lead the way.
ctx.work: Your emotional intelligence and intuition are powerful assets at work. Caring professions, healing arts, counselling and creative work are especially favoured. Lead with empathy, trust your instincts about people, and avoid taking on everyone's emotional burdens.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through your intuition, dreams and psychic senses. The queen's closed cup holds sacred mysteries, and she invites you to gaze into them. Water rituals, scrying and meditation can deepen your connection to divine guidance and the Great Mother.
ctx.release: Release the habit of absorbing everyone else's feelings. Let go of martyrdom or caretaking that leaves you depleted. You may also need to release doubt about your intuition; your inner knowing is trustworthy, and it grows clearer each time you honour it.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be deep feelings or psychic impressions you have not acknowledged. Your blind spot might be how much you take on from others, or how much you need the very care you so freely give. Turn your compassion inward.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lie compassion, intuition and emotional depth. Your capacity to feel, nurture and understand underlies what is happening now. Trust that this sensitive foundation is a source of real strength.
ctx.gift: Your gift is profound empathy and intuitive wisdom. You can sense what others need and offer healing simply by being present. Hidden help may come from a nurturing person or from your own inner knowing, guiding you clearly.

name: King of Cups
imagery: A king sits on a stone throne that floats steadily on a turbulent sea, holding a cup in one hand and a sceptre in the other, with a fish amulet around his neck. A ship sails on one side and a dolphin leaps on the other. His calm amid rough waters symbolises emotional mastery, while the fish and dolphin show his deep connection to feeling and intuition, and the ship his ability to navigate the world.
meaning: The King of Cups is the master of emotional balance — he feels deeply but is not ruled by his feelings. Waite described him as fair, considerate and kind, a man of responsibility and creative intelligence. He leads with compassion and diplomacy, staying calm when others are swept away by the waves. This card asks you to bring wisdom and composure to emotional situations, balancing heart and mind. It may also represent a mature, caring person who offers steady support and counsel. Be the calm at the centre of the storm.
numerology: King: mastery turned outward — the mature, authoritative expression of the suit, leading and protecting with its energy.
affirmation: I stay calm and compassionate, mastering my emotions with wisdom and grace.

ctx.past: A wise, emotionally balanced figure — a father, mentor or your own mature self — shaped your past. Perhaps you learned to stay calm under pressure or to lead with kindness. That grounding influence still steadies you as you navigate the present.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter calls for emotional balance and wisdom. You may be navigating stormy feelings, your own or others', and are asked to stay calm and compassionate. Lead with diplomacy, keeping your head steady and your heart open.
ctx.future: You are moving toward emotional maturity and steadiness. A wise, caring person may offer support, or you may grow into the role of calm leader and counsellor. Whatever the waves, you will be able to remain centred and kind.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is suppressing your feelings in the name of control, or appearing calm while turmoil churns beneath. You may be emotionally distant or overly diplomatic, avoiding honest conflict. Real mastery means feeling fully and still choosing wisely.
ctx.advice: Respond rather than react. Take a breath, feel what is there, and then act with compassion and clarity. Offer counsel and support to those around you, and set calm boundaries. Grounding practices and water meditations can help you stay centred.
ctx.self: You see yourself as emotionally mature, calm and wise — or you aspire to be. You may be the steady presence others rely on. Make sure your composure includes room for your own feelings; a king must also tend his own heart.
ctx.others: Others see you as wise, dependable and kind, a natural counsellor or leader. A mature, compassionate person in your environment may be offering support or guidance. Outside influences call for diplomacy and emotional steadiness, and people may look to you to keep the peace when tempers rise.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel calm, balanced and in control of your emotional life. You may fear being overwhelmed by feelings or losing your composure. The card reassures you that emotional mastery is within reach, through practice and self-compassion.
ctx.love: Love is mature, stable and emotionally supportive. This card often signals a caring, devoted partner or a relationship grounded in mutual respect and wisdom. Communicate calmly, listen deeply and lead your bond with kindness and patience.
ctx.work: You are called to lead with emotional intelligence. Diplomacy, counselling, mediation and caring leadership roles are favoured. Stay calm under pressure and balance compassion with sound judgement; your steadiness will earn trust and respect, and it may open doors to greater responsibility.
ctx.spirit: Spirit asks you to master your emotional waters while staying connected to the deep. Your guides may be a wise, fatherly presence, teaching you that calm itself is a spiritual power. Meditation and contemplation help you ride the waves of intuition.
ctx.release: Release the need to control your emotions or others'. Let go of the mask of composure if it hides what you truly feel. You may also need to release old patterns of emotional suppression learned from authority figures in your life.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be feelings you keep tightly controlled beneath a calm exterior. Your blind spot might be how much you hold in, or how others perceive your diplomacy as distance. Let your deep waters be seen by those you trust.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is emotional maturity and the ability to stay steady amid turbulence. Your wisdom, compassion and calm underlie what is happening now. That inner composure is the throne on which everything else rests.
ctx.gift: Your gift is emotional mastery: the ability to feel deeply while remaining calm, kind and clear. You are a steadying presence for others. Hidden help may come from a wise mentor or from your own centred heart guiding you through the storm.
